# VerticalTabItem

```ts
import { VerticalTabItem } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A top-level row in a vertical tab rail (Figma ".elements/vert_tab_item", node 145:8456) — the settings-style navigation where the rail sits beside its panel.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | **required** | Value linking this row to its VerticalTabsContent panel. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The row label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims the row and drops it from the tab order. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | — | Marks this row as owning sub-items and sets their disclosure state. Passing it renders the trailing chevron and sets aria-expanded; leave it undefined for a plain row. |
| `onExpandedChange` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` | — | Fires with the next disclosure state when a collapsible row is activated. |

Also accepts all `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixTabs.Trigger>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
import {
  VerticalTabs, VerticalTabsList, VerticalTabsContent, VerticalTabItem,
} from '@/cakeand/components/VerticalTabs';

<VerticalTabs defaultValue="home">
  <VerticalTabsList aria-label="Settings sections">
    <VerticalTabItem value="home">Home</VerticalTabItem>
    <VerticalTabItem value="account">Account</VerticalTabItem>
    <VerticalTabItem value="archived" disabled>Archived</VerticalTabItem>
  </VerticalTabsList>

  <VerticalTabsContent value="home">…</VerticalTabsContent>
  <VerticalTabsContent value="account">…</VerticalTabsContent>
</VerticalTabs>
```

## Accessibility

- Radix supplies the tablist/tab/tabpanel roles and aria-selected, and links each row to its panel — so the rail is announced as tabs, not buttons.
- Vertical orientation means Up/Down arrows move between rows, with Home/End jumping to the ends. Only the selected row is in the tab order; Tab moves on to the panel.
- Selection is never conveyed by color alone — the selected row also goes bold and gains the leading indicator (WCAG 1.4.1).
- Always give VerticalTabsList an aria-label so the rail has a name.
- Long labels truncate with an ellipsis rather than reflowing the fixed row.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Give the rail an aria-label describing what it navigates. | Leave the tablist unnamed. |
| Keep labels short so they don't truncate. | Rely on the ellipsis to hide long labels. |
| Use VerticalTabSubItem for a nested level. | Indent a VerticalTabItem by hand to fake nesting. |
| Use activationMode="manual" when a panel is expensive to load. | Let automatic activation fire heavy fetches on arrow-key browsing. |
